name: clew
description: Index a C, C++, Rust or Python repository into a queryable graph — symbols, call edges, callbacks, threads, locks, dataflow, requirement links and prose — and serve it over MCP. Installs four tools AND one PostToolUse hook that notes the index after Bash/Grep/Glob/Read while it goes unused, escalating as unused calls accumulate and going silent again once it is used (disable with CLEW_HOOK_DISABLE=1). Requires the clew-trace package on PATH and the doxygen binary.
